elements.requirement: A relevant commercial organisation is guilty of an offence if a person associated with it bribes another person intending to obtain or retain business for the organisation.
elements.quote: A relevant commercial organisation (“C”) is guilty of an offence under this section if a person (“A”) associated with C bribes another person intending— (a) to obtain or retain business for C

elements.requirement: A relevant commercial organisation is guilty of an offence if a person associated with it bribes another person intending to obtain or retain an advantage in the conduct of business for the organisation.
elements.quote: to obtain or retain an advantage in the conduct of business for C

elements.requirement: A relevant commercial organisation has a defence against the offence if it proves that it had in place adequate procedures designed to prevent persons associated with it from undertaking such conduct.
elements.quote: it is a defence for C to prove that C had in place adequate procedures designed to prevent persons associated with C from undertaking such conduct

elements.requirement: A person bribes another person if, and only if, that person is, or would be, guilty of an offence under section 1 or section 6, whether or not that person has been prosecuted for such an offence.
elements.quote: A bribes another person if, and only if, A— (a) is, or would be, guilty of an offence under section 1 or 6 (whether or not A has been prosecuted for such an offence)

elements.requirement: A person bribes another person if, and only if, that person would be guilty of an offence under section 1 or section 6 if section 12(2)(c) and section 12(4) were omitted.
elements.quote: would be guilty of such an offence if section 12(2)(c) and (4) were omitted

elements.requirement: The meaning of a person associated with a commercial organisation is set out in section 8, and the Secretary of State's duty to publish guidance is set out in section 9.
elements.quote: See section 8 for the meaning of a person associated with C and see section 9 for a duty on the Secretary of State to publish guidance

elements.requirement: A partnership includes a partnership within the Partnership Act 1890.
elements.quote: a partnership within the Partnership Act 1890

elements.requirement: A partnership includes a limited partnership registered under the Limited Partnerships Act 1907.
elements.quote: a limited partnership registered under the Limited Partnerships Act 1907

elements.requirement: A partnership includes a firm or entity of a similar character formed under the law of a country or territory outside the United Kingdom.
elements.quote: a firm or entity of a similar character formed under the law of a country or territory outside the United Kingdom

elements.requirement: A relevant commercial organisation includes a body incorporated under the law of any part of the United Kingdom that carries on a business, whether there or elsewhere.
elements.quote: a body which is incorporated under the law of any part of the United Kingdom and which carries on a business (whether there or elsewhere)

elements.requirement: A relevant commercial organisation includes any other body corporate, wherever incorporated, that carries on a business, or part of a business, in any part of the United Kingdom.
elements.quote: any other body corporate (wherever incorporated) which carries on a business, or part of a business, in any part of the United Kingdom

elements.requirement: A relevant commercial organisation includes a partnership formed under the law of any part of the United Kingdom that carries on a business, whether there or elsewhere.
elements.quote: a partnership which is formed under the law of any part of the United Kingdom and which carries on a business (whether there or elsewhere)

elements.requirement: A relevant commercial organisation includes any other partnership, wherever formed, that carries on a business, or part of a business, in any part of the United Kingdom.
elements.quote: any other partnership (wherever formed) which carries on a business, or part of a business, in any part of the United Kingdom

elements.requirement: For the purposes of section 7, a trade or profession is treated as a business.
elements.quote: for the purposes of this section, a trade or profession is a business
